package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for config_file_read_per_request: `os.ReadFile("config.json")` or `viper.ReadInConfig()` inside handler or loop code
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func scenario406Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("config.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/yaml")
	w.Write(data)
}
